emojis.title: Why China Isn’t Pushing Iran to Accept U.S. Demands to End War
emojis.summary: Despite the economic risks from the war, Beijing will likely stick to a hands-off approach. It is wary of being entangled in a conflict it opposed and has little sway over.

emojis.summary: For days, Pope Leo XIV has attracted criticism from President Trump and his allies for refusing to back the war in Iran. On Thursday, he reiterated his calls for peace.
